source: Ported from an earlier internal calculator benchmark library
notes: Time-saved benchmarks per capability. Conservative leans on independent trials (Microsoft Research RCT arXiv 2504.11443, UK DBT and Australian DTA trials), optimistic on vendor claims; vendor-funded studies are flagged.

conservative.rationale: Broad-rollout adoption floor (20-30% weekly active); 40% of saved time lost to rework (Workday).

typical.rationale: MS Research RCT: 38% of licensed users active weekly; midpoint of the 30-50% realisation convention.

optimistic.rationale: UK DBT self-selected pilot ~66% weekly use; upper end of the realisation convention.

roles.label: Knowledge worker
roles.source: StatCan professional, scientific and technical services 2024 wage x 1.30 loading

roles.label: Engineer
roles.source: Assumption; GetDX developer examples run USD 75-150

capabilities.label: Meeting prep + summary
capabilities.sourceLabel: MS Research RCT (no net meeting saving); AU DTA trial 50-70% perceived; Forrester TEI (vendor)
capabilities.note: The one RCT found zero net meeting-time saving once work shifted into meetings; the write-up saving is real, the prep saving is unmeasured.

capabilities.label: Finding information (KB Ask)
capabilities.sourceLabel: Glean vendor 3-11 h/wk; AU DTA trial; McKinsey 19%-of-week search baseline
capabilities.note: No vendor-neutral timed study of grounded Q&A exists; the typical value is a heavily discounted vendor range.

capabilities.label: Conversational Q&A (Search QA)
capabilities.sourceLabel: Overlaps KB Ask; counting both double-counts the same questions
capabilities.note: Off by default: the same 'finding information' benefit as KB Ask. Enable only if the KB Ask row is zeroed.

capabilities.label: BRD / requirements drafting
capabilities.sourceLabel: Extrapolated: MS Research RCT 6-12% document completion; GitHub Copilot RCT 55% on a coding task
capabilities.note: No timed BA-specific study exists. The pilot's 'requirements kept after review' metric is the real test.

capabilities.label: Structured documents
capabilities.sourceLabel: MS Research RCT: 6% (all users) / 12% (regular users) faster document completion

capabilities.label: Decks from a brief
capabilities.sourceLabel: UK DBT trial: faster but lower-quality slides; vendor anecdote 3-4 h to 28 min
capabilities.note: Quality caveat: the independent trial found worse output, so conservative is zero and a review step is assumed.

capabilities.label: Voice notes to actions
capabilities.sourceLabel: Otter.ai vendor claim 4+ h/wk on meeting admin, discounted

capabilities.label: Daily digest / email triage
capabilities.sourceLabel: MS Research RCT: 12 min/wk all users, 30+ min/wk regular users; Worklab per-company 40-50 min

capabilities.label: DevOps work items
capabilities.sourceLabel: No direct evidence; extrapolated from the GitHub Copilot RCT and document numbers

capabilities.label: M365 lookups
capabilities.sourceLabel: Overlaps 'Finding information'; Copilot covers it natively for licensed users
capabilities.note: Off by default to avoid double-counting the search benefit.
